record.paper_title: Negative (and Positive) Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Fix a graph Γ and a length k. Characterize the set C_k(Γ) of all possible numbers of negative circles of length k that can occur over all signatures of Γ.

evidence.quote: Qn. 1. Characterize the set of numbers of negative circles of some fixed length of all signatures of a fixed graph Γ; that is, the set Ck(Γ) = {c−k(Γ, σ) : σ is a signature of Γ} for some fixed k, 3 ≤ k ≤ n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair (Γ, σ) consisting of a finite simple graph Γ = (V, E) together with a signature σ : E → {+1, −1}. A circle (cycle) C in Γ is called negative under σ if the product ∏_{e ∈ E(C)} σ(e) equals −1, and positive otherwise. For a graph Γ on n vertices, an integer k with 3 ≤ k ≤ n, and a signature σ of Γ, let c_k^{−}(Γ, σ) denote the number of negative circles of length k in (Γ, σ). Define
   C_k(Γ) = { c_k^{−}(Γ, σ) : σ is a signature of Γ } ⊆ ℤ_{≥0}.
Problem: For a fixed graph Γ and a fixed integer k with 3 ≤ k ≤ n, give a combinatorial characterization of the set C_k(Γ); that is, determine exactly which nonnegative integers arise as the number of negative k-circles of some signature of Γ.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a problem collection on negative circles in signed graphs and remains broadly open. Partial results are known: Schaefer and Zaslavsky have shown that the dimension of the negative-circle vector set attains its maximum for complete graphs K_n and complete bipartite graphs K_{r,s}, but a general characterization of C_k(Γ) for arbitrary Γ and k has not been found.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs: A problem collection
status_evidence.snippet: Problem collection listing open questions on counts of negative circles in signatures of fixed graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization of C_k(Γ) is posed as an open problem in a collection of unsolved questions.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Negative Circles Versus Best Clustering in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work continues to investigate negative-circle structures in signed graphs, indicating the area remains active.
status_evidence.claim: Research on negative-circle counts is ongoing with no general characterization of C_k(Γ) reported.
